description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Runtime_Make_Nocache which contains runtime methods for handling 'no-cache' variable management in Smarty templates, including saving variable states and storing them in cache context.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Runtime_Make_Nocache
classes.description: Runtime class providing methods to manage nocache variables during template rendering in Smarty.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current value of a variable during template rendering and injects nocache code.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Stores a variable's value in the cache context, ensuring nocache variables are not overwritten.
